A-I1.quote: This work describes the key elements in a Smart Metering system and compiles the most employed technologies and standards as well as their main features.

A-I2.quote: State of the Art and Trends Review of Smart Metering in Electricity Grids

A-I3.quote: Also data protection and security issues must be addressed. Not all technologies offer the same security levels and this needs to be faced.

A-I4.quote: Academic Editor: Minho Shin Received: 29 October 2015; Accepted: 22 January 2016; Published: 29 February 2016

parsed.rationale: This is a peer-reviewed MDPI review whose principal subject is smart metering. Privacy appears only in passing: as table entries ('Security & privacy', 'Access to personal data' in a planning-considerations table), as one bullet on 'Protection of sensitive data', and in a few sentences in the challenges section. There is no dedicated privacy section, no comparison dimension across surveyed works, and privacy is not a stated aim, so A-I3 is not met (A-E6).
